# wacc.less.style

> Free WACC calculator using Damodaran sector betas, Fernandez country risk premiums, Kroll size premiums, and country tax rates.

## Pages

- [WACC Calculator](https://wacc.less.style/): Interactive calculator for weighted average cost of capital, cost of equity (CAPM), and after-tax cost of debt
- [WACC Guide](https://wacc.less.style/guide): WACC formula, CAPM, levered beta, cost of debt, data sources, and how to use the calculator
- [WACC vs Cost of Equity](https://wacc.less.style/guide/wacc-vs-cost-of-equity): Cost of equity is the return owners expect; WACC is the blended cost of owners and lenders
- [Damodaran WACC Calculator](https://wacc.less.style/guide/damodaran-wacc): How Damodaran sector betas, country tax rates, and default spreads are applied

## Calculator method

- Cost of equity: ke = rf + βL × MRP + size premium + additional risk
- Levered beta: βL = βU × [1 + (1 − T) × (D / E)]
- Cost of debt: kd = rf + credit spread from interest coverage
- WACC: (E / V) × ke + (D / V) × kd × (1 − T)

## Data sources

- Fernandez, 2025 (2024 fallback): market risk premium and risk-free rate by country
- Damodaran, January 2026: global sector betas, country tax rates, ratings and default spreads
- Kroll, 2025: size risk premium
